title: 第9章 仙子这是看上我了第10章 合欢丹血契兰月儿
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
李安始终相信，出门在外，身份是自己给的。
何况他现在的灵魂已经达到了火工童子的水平，只是境界有些低微。
不过炼气三层的水平，也算是摸到了火工童子的门槛。
只要有人引见给炼丹师，炼丹师觉得合适，就可以从见习童子开始做起，成为火工童子。
最后尝试炼丹，成为九品下炼丹师。
当然，说起来容易，实际上想要真正成为火工童子，可不是一件容易的事情。
首先灵魂天赋就较为少见，若是没有天赋，就需要丹药进补。
而真正的丹药，可不是凡夫俗子可以接触到的东西。
在丹圣宗，就算是有天赋，若是没有背景，那也只会沦为其他人的耗材。
如同此前宁荣荣和兰月儿算计他那样，有时候，天赋反倒成了催命符。
即便不被人盯上，能否得到其他火工童子的推荐，乃至是被真正的炼丹师看中。
都不是一件容易的事情。
不过，兰月儿已经是一位火工童子，若是能走通她的门路，成为火工童子，倒不是一件难事。
至于三百灵石，在李安看来，反倒是不需要那么在意。
毕竟他现在有九十九缕阴阳气，只要合成出一枚九品丹药，就能卖出一百灵石左右的价格。
管事婆婆见李安说得如此笃定，连连点头。
两天时间，她自然是等得起。
“好，既然这位大人定下了日子，此事就这么定了，大人放心，这两天，我们一定将冰儿照顾得白白胖胖，不会让大人你失望！”
管事婆婆轻笑着道。

李安知道她这番话潜在意思是什么，若是两天之后，没有拿来灵石，冰儿的处境如何，她们就不会保证了。
“少不了你们的，好好伺候着吧。”李安喝了一口茶水，然后就转身离开。
管事婆婆亲自将李安送到门口，目送他走下二楼，这才转身离开。
而李安走下二楼这才松了口气，要是被管事婆婆拆穿了身份，冰儿以后的处境如何，那就不好说了。
好在是糊弄过去了。
“这次回去之后，必须尽快成为火工童子才行，有了这个身份，以后售卖丹药也会容易很多。”
李安呢喃自语，心中很快做出了决定。
而当他走到立春院大门时，周通也是神清气爽的走了出来。
“李兄，你是不知道，人妖的滋味真是不错啊！”
“足足折腾了一个时辰，我这境界都有了松动的迹象！”
一见到李安，周通就忍不住炫耀起来。
他乃是四灵根，能修行到炼气二层，都是因为运气不错，找到过一些蕴含药性的废丹，日积月累之下，才达到了这一境界。
原本以为突破无望，可眼下因为那狐女，却是让他看到了更大的希望。
李安默默听着。
昨晚折腾一夜之后，他的境界来到了炼气三层，灵魂也得到了增强，几乎有了脱胎换骨的提升。
周通的这点提升，李安并未放在眼里。
不过，这也能看出冰儿的特殊，根本不是一般的人妖姑娘可比。
“哎，也不知道那些身怀元阴的人妖姑娘，又是什么滋味，若是能一夜风流，便是折寿十年，我也愿意啊！”

Ang Lee always believes that when you go out, your identity is given by yourself.
What's more, his soul has now reached the level of a fire worker boy, but his realm is a bit low.
However, the level of the third level of Qi Refining can be regarded as touching the threshold of a fire worker boy.
As long as someone is introduced to the alchemist, and the alchemist thinks it is suitable, he can start as a trainee boy and become a fire worker boy.
Finally, he tried alchemy and became a ninth-grade alchemist.
Of course, it is easy to say that, but in fact it is not easy to truly become a fire boy.
First of all, soul talent is relatively rare. If you don't have talent, you need to supplement it with elixirs.
The real elixir is not something that ordinary people can come into contact with.
In the Alchemy Sect, even if you have talent, if you have no background, you will only become a consumable for others.
Just like how Ning Rongrong and Lan Yue'er plotted against him before, sometimes his talent turned out to be a talisman to his death.
Even if he is not targeted by others, can he be recommended by other fire workers, or even be favored by a real alchemist?
None of it is easy.
However, Lan Yue'er is already a pyrotechnics boy. If he can find a way through her and become a pyrotechnics boy, it will not be difficult.
As for the three hundred spirit stones, in Li An's opinion, there is no need to care so much.
After all, he now has ninety-nine strands of yin and yang energy. As long as he synthesizes a ninth-grade elixir, he can sell it for about one hundred spiritual stones.
The housekeeper's mother-in-law nodded repeatedly when she saw that Li An spoke so firmly.
She could certainly afford to wait for two days.
"Okay, now that your Excellency has set a date, this matter is settled. Don't worry, Your Excellency, we will definitely take care of Bing'er in these two days and we will not let you down, Your Excellency!"
The housekeeper said with a chuckle.
Li An knew the underlying meaning of her words. If the spirit stone was not brought in two days later, they would not be able to guarantee Bing'er's situation.
"I can't do without you, so take good care of me." Li An took a sip of tea, then turned and left.
The housekeeper's mother-in-law personally walked Li An to the door, watched him walk down the second floor, and then turned around and left.
Li An was relieved when he walked down the second floor. If the housekeeper's mother-in-law exposed her identity, it would be hard to say what Bing'er's situation would be in the future.
Fortunately, it was fooled.
"After returning this time, I must become a fire boy as soon as possible. With this identity, it will be much easier to sell pills in the future."
Li An murmured to himself, quickly making a decision in his mind.
And when he walked to the gate of Li Chun Yuan, Zhou Tong also walked out refreshed.
"Brother Li, you don't know, the taste of a shemale is really good!"
"After struggling for an hour, my realm is showing signs of loosening!"
As soon as he saw Li An, Zhou Tong couldn't help but show off.
He has four spiritual roots, and he was able to reach the second level of Qi Refining because he was lucky and found some useless pills that contained medicinal properties. Over time, he reached this level.
He originally thought there was no hope of breaking through, but now because of the fox girl, he saw greater hope.
Li An listened silently.
After struggling all night last night, his realm reached the third level of Qi refining, and his soul was strengthened, almost completely improved.
Li An didn't take Zhou Tong's improvement seriously.
However, this also shows that Bing'er is special, not comparable to ordinary shemale girls.
"Hey, I don't know what it's like for those shemale girls who are pregnant with Yuanyin. If I can have a romantic affair overnight, it means losing ten years of my life. I'm willing to do that!"
